corpus: regional tuition exchanges at a named school (RFC 277, slice shape/09/exchange-participation)
method: Each row was read from the school's own page. The sentences behind each value are recorded here for review in the diff; they are never loaded. unit_id was resolved against the College Scorecard institution file by exact INSTNM match and confirmed by STABBR. Link statuses were produced with `nix develop -c bin/check-link` (a HEAD pass and a -g GET pass) and mapped the way bin/cds-link-sweep does: 2xx in either pass is found.
source_of_quotes: product/0017-beat-the-chatbots-on-cost/research/fresher-prices-and-exchanges.md, section B, the table 'The six schools under the compacts'; the wording is that table's, some of it in quotation marks there and some of it its summary of the page
refresh_instruction: Re-read each school's own page, edit db/seed/tuition-exchanges/exchanges.csv and this file's matching rows entry, and re-run the loader. A correction is a re-read, so it carries a new checked_on. A deadline stated as a month and day is stored as its next occurrence after checked_on; expires_on is HandTypedReferenceData.CYCLE_EXPIRY following that deadline, or following checked_on when no deadline is held. Re-verify the urls with bin/check-link twice (HEAD, then -g for GET). The build fails HandTypedReferenceData.REFRESH_LEAD before expires_on.
